Once it strikes or misses a target, an integrated anti-grav field traces its flight path and returns it to the wielder, who can catch it easily. The weapon can typically be drawn, thrown, and retrieved in a single attack action.
The sickle is compact enough to carry in a belt or harness and is favored by operatives who want a reusable thrown option without the bulk of a full-sized weapon. The return mechanism makes it ideal for hit-and-run and multiple targets in sequence. In the right hands, the Return-Sickle is both tool and statement.
With the Return-Sickle, the wielder can strike at range and have the weapon back without closing.
Effects
— Return to wielder after strike or miss; draw, throw, and retrieve in one Atk action.

weapons.name: Rift Blade
weapons.notes:
Rift Blade
The Rift Blade is a short, lethal weapon designed for the character, perfectly suited for close-quarters combat and spellcasting. Infused with void energy, the blade enhances the character's ability to channel the raw power of the void, allowing them to cast devastating spells and maintain control over the battlefield. The Rift Blade is a fusion of dark elegance and deadly power, its very presence exuding an aura of menace.
When the character wields the Rift Blade, the weapon seems to drink in the light, its dark metal surface shimmering with an ethereal glow. Intricate void runes etched along the blade pulse with deep purple light, casting eerie reflections on nearby surfaces. As the character strikes, the blade leaves behind a trail of shadowy energy that crackles and snaps in the air. The weapon hums with barely contained power, resonating with the character’s intent and amplifying their control over the void. To those who face the Rift Blade, it appears as if the character is wielding a piece of the void itself, capable of severing the ties between reality and oblivion.
The Rift Blade is not just a weapon; it is a conduit for the character's immense power, turning each strike into an opportunity to bend the battlefield to their will.

weapons.name: Rotary Plasma Gun
weapons.notes:
The Rotary Plasma Gun mounts six barrels that spin as they fire, each spitting a mass of white-hot plasma. The barrels are cooled by a liquid nitrogen jacket. The weapon is supplied by a plasma precipitator pack (see equipment); the same pack can power a plasma sword or other plasma devices.
The gun must be spun up for one full round before it can be fired safely; firing before the barrels reach optimal rotation risks burning them out if damage rolls are high. When activated, the gun emits a constant hum or whine that is clearly audible nearby. With the Rotary Plasma Gun, the wielder brings maximum plasma firepower to the fight.
Effects
— One full round to spin up before use; early fire can burn out barrels; precipitator pack powers weapon and other plasma gear.

weapons.name: Scimitar
weapons.notes: Scimitar is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Seeker Rifle
weapons.notes:
The Seeker Rifle is a slender, long-barreled weapon that fires small guided projectiles capable of curving around corners and over obstacles to strike targets that would be protected from line-of-sight fire. The projectiles are less destructive than full seeker missiles but share the same homing principle, making the rifle ideal for engaging foes in cover or behind partial concealment.
The rifle negates defense modifiers that would apply from partial cover, as the rounds can adjust their trajectory to find a path to the target. This makes it a favorite of urban fighters and anyone who regularly faces entrenched or sheltered opponents. The trade-off is limited payload and the need for a clear initial lock.
With the Seeker Rifle, the wielder can hit what others cannot even see.
Effects
— Homing projectiles; negates defense modifiers for partial cover.

weapons.name: Serrated Maul
weapons.notes:
The Serrated Maul is a fearsome two-handed pole weapon, nearly seven feet from end to end, that combines the reach of a spear with the cutting power of multiple blades. The head is a mass of barbs, flanges, and edges designed to cut and tear rather than simply pierce. It is favored by warriors who want to dominate reach and leave lasting wounds.
High-quality Serrated Mauls are often forged with labor-intensive methods—repeated folding and tempering of the steel—to produce blades that hold an edge and resist shattering. The result is a weapon that can hook, slash, and impale in a single fluid motion. Its size demands two hands and significant strength, but in return it offers unmatched presence in the melee.
The Serrated Maul turns every swing into a statement of intent.
Effects
— Two-handed; multi-bladed head for cutting and tearing.

weapons.name: Shadow Orb
weapons.notes:
Shadow Orb
The Shadow Orb is an enigmatic and powerful weapon designed for the character, serving as both a focus for their spells and a tool for controlling the battlefield. This floating orb enhances the character’s ability to harness void energy, unleashing bursts of dark power that weaken enemy formations and turn the tide of battle. The orb is a mesmerizing sphere of dark, translucent crystal that absorbs and refracts light, its surface constantly shifting with shadowy tendrils of void energy.
When the character summons the Shadow Orb, it hovers effortlessly by their side, its dark surface swirling with an ever-changing pattern of darkness and light. The orb seems almost alive, pulsing with void energy that resonates with the character’s intentions. As it floats through the air, it leaves a faint trail of shadowy mist in its wake, the void energy within crackling softly like distant thunder. When the character releases a bolt of void energy from the orb, the dark projectile streaks through the air like a bolt of lightning, striking with deadly precision and devastating power. To allies and enemies alike, the Shadow Orb is a symbol of the character’s mastery over the void, a weapon of both beauty and terror.
The Shadow Orb is not just a weapon but an extension of the character’s will, turning the raw energy of the void into a tool of both destruction and control.

weapons.name: Short Sword
weapons.notes: Short Sword is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Shoulder-Blades
weapons.notes:
Shoulder-Blades are semi-circular blades that are partially implanted in the patient’s shoulder or leg. The blades are made of an ultra-light alloy, and are equipped with a tracking system (much like a targeting computer \- see *EM, tech equipment*).
When the user issues a mental command, a blade will fly out to strike a designated opponent. After use, the blade may be retrieved and reattached.
Shoulder-Blades are a common cyber implant; some users mount several at once.

weapons.name: Shredder Cannon
weapons.notes:
The Shredder Cannon is a two-handed weapon that fires spinning crescents of metal, related in principle to disk weapons but optimized for shredding and area damage. It is durable and bulky; in a pinch it can be used as a club in melee, dealing set damage with the same attack roll as when fired. Operators favor it for the gruesome wounds and psychological impact it creates.
The weapon is too heavy for one-handed use and requires a committed grip. The crescents spin through the air and tear through light armor and flesh, making it effective against grouped or unarmored targets. Reload and maintenance are straightforward, and the Shredder Cannon has become a standard option for troops who want maximum close-range devastation.
With the Shredder Cannon, the wielder can turn a corridor or breach into a killing zone.
Effects
— May be used as club in melee for 10L damage (same attack roll as when shot).

weapons.name: Sickle
weapons.notes: Sickle is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Siege Fist
weapons.notes:
This massive appendage is designed to do maximum punch damage. During the operation, the patient’s forearm is removed and the cyber fist is attached in its place.
The fist has an outer weighted sheath which can be mentally commanded to slide down and over the user’s knuckles. This sheath contains several sturdy spikes to aid in the blow.
It is a horrible thing when a cyber lord activates their cyber-fist, and opponents have come to dread the sound of the sheath as it slides forward.
A cyber-fist increases punch damage by \+2d with the sheath back and \+1c when it is slid forward.
The fists’s fingers are equipped with joint locks and power joints (double any grip type Str roll).
This fist also adds \+1 to a character’s vitality maximum, but has no impact upon the character’s Vitality rating.

weapons.name: Siege Hammer
weapons.notes: Siege Hammer is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Silenced Plasma Pistol
weapons.notes:
Silenced Plasma Pistol
The Silenced Plasma Pistol is an advanced sidearm engineered for the character, optimized for stealth and close-quarters combat. This compact weapon is designed to fire energy rounds with lethal precision while maintaining the utmost silence, making it indispensable for covert operations and missions that require remaining undetected.
When the character draws the Silenced Plasma Pistol, the weapon’s matte black surface absorbs the surrounding light, allowing it to blend seamlessly into the shadows. The pistol emits a soft hum as it charges, but when fired, the energy round exits the barrel with barely a whisper, leaving only a faint blue trail in its wake. The shot lands with pinpoint accuracy, incapacitating the target without alerting others in the vicinity. The ergonomic grip ensures the character can maintain control even in the heat of battle, allowing for swift and silent eliminations.
The Silenced Plasma Pistol empowers the character to strike from the shadows, executing their missions with deadly efficiency and leaving no trace behind.
Effects
-- Silent, energy-based sidearm designed for stealth and close-quarters combat.

weapons.name: Sonic Disrupter
weapons.notes:
A sonic disrupter sets up atomic-level vibrations in solid objects, which causes molecular bonds to break down and matter to literally shake apart. The device was designed for use against fortifications (walls, doors, bulk heads, etc.) and terrain obstacles (trees, boulders, etc.) but is gaining popularity with the Guild marines for use against heavily armored opponents, and light vehicles.
The denser the object, the greater the damage (GM’ discretion). Boulders and solid steel walls often result in damage as high as 6LV (the maximum this weapon can cause). When used against rigid armor, damage matches the opponent's AR rating. Thus, if the opponent is wearing 16 (or 8M) armor, the disrupter causes 8M damage. If attached to a power supply, this weapon draws 20 srg per shot regardless of the target or damage rating.
Against less dense or rigid armor, the weapon only causes half as much damage.
Each time the disrupter exceeds the armor value of a target, it permanently reduces the armor value by 1d (Natural Armor is exempt from this rule) although the disrupters damage maintains at the armor's original AR.

weapons.name: Sonic Sword
weapons.notes:
The Sonic Sword appears as a small hand grip until activated, when three prongs at the base generate a vibrating field of air molecules that extends about three feet. The blade damages targets by disrupting their molecular structure. It can also be used against stationary obstacles—walls, doors—by holding the blade in contact; the weapon inflicts cumulative damage each round until the object is destroyed, though the object may explode when broken, dealing damage based on its AR.
In vacuum or underwater, the blade can detonate for 6Mx damage under certain conditions. The weapon is a favorite of breachers and duelists who want a blade that can cut through almost anything and double as a door-killer. Care must be taken when destroying objects to avoid the backlash.
With the Sonic Sword, the wielder carries a blade that shakes matter apart.
Effects
— Three-foot vibrating field; cumulative damage vs stationary objects; possible detonation in space/water; destroyed objects may explode for AR-based damage.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.notes:
The Spear has changed little in principle since its earliest use: a long shaft with a pointed head, for thrusting and throwing. Modern versions use durable alloys for the shaft and head, making them nearly unbreakable under normal use. They remain a staple on low-tech and frontier worlds, used for hunting, militia duty, and combat.
The spear offers reach and versatility—it can be thrown or used in melee, and formations of spears can hold ground against heavier opponents. Its simplicity makes it easy to produce and repair almost anywhere. In the right hands, the spear is both tool and weapon, as effective in the field as in the line.
With the Spear, the wielder has reach and penetration in one package.
Effects
— None

weapons.name: Spore Blaster
weapons.notes:
Spore Blaster
The Spore Blaster is an advanced ranged weapon designed for the character, a master of biotechnology focused on technological support and innovation. This unique weapon fires concentrated spores capable of entangling enemies or delivering bioelectric shocks, making it perfect for both offensive and defensive operations. The Spore Blaster leverages the character’s expertise in biotechnology, turning them into a formidable presence on the battlefield and a crucial asset to the hive.
The Spore Blaster is a sleek and intricate device, combining organic and mechanical components in a seamless design. The main body of the weapon is constructed from a lightweight, durable bio-polymer, with a surface that mimics the texture of living tissue. Bioluminescent veins run along the length of the weapon, pulsing with a soft green glow that indicates its readiness and the potency of the spores within. When fired, the weapon emits a low, resonant hum, followed by the sudden release of spores that swirl and coalesce into a dense cloud before striking their target with pinpoint accuracy.
The Spore Blaster exemplifies the character’s ability to manipulate the environment, turning the very air around their enemies into a weapon of entrapment and shock.
Effects
-- Fires concentrated spores with special effects.
-- The weapon is both offensive and defensive.

weapons.name: Strangle Spear
weapons.notes: To an outside observer, this weapon would resemble a poorly carved wooden spear. In reality, when this living weapon hits its target (inflicting 10L damage), it immediately transforms into a sinuous, ropy strand which will attempt to loop around and strangle its victim. This strangling attack is made at the spear’s rating (10/16/1). If it hits, it will use its Str (16 or 8M) vs the victim's FR in an attempt to strangle the victim. If successful the victim begins suffocating. Victims may attempt to break free each round (Str check vs the spear's Str of 16 (8M)).|

weapons.name: Stun
weapons.notes:
The Stun is a compact handheld weapon that uses focused sound waves to overwhelm the nervous system and knock targets unconscious. Attack rolls are made normally; effect is resolved against the target's WP rather than AR. If the roll exceeds the target's WP, the victim falls unconscious for a number of rounds equal to the margin of success. Beings who cannot hear or who wear protective headgear receive a bonus to their WP when resisting.
With the Stun, the wielder can drop a foe without drawing blood.
Effects
— Effect vs WP; success margin = rounds unconscious; deaf or helmeted targets get +1c to WP.

weapons.name: Sun-Blades
weapons.notes:
The Sun-Blades are a paired set of exotic blades forged from a metal that naturally stores solar energy and releases it as a powerful shock when triggered. The blades are detachable and can be left in direct sunlight to recharge; after at least a half-hour in full sun, each blade can deliver one stun discharge. The wielder releases the stored energy by depressing a hidden stud, and the target must resist or be stunned for a number of rounds equal to the failure.
If both blades are charged and set to discharge at once, the combined effect is more severe. The weapon is unusual in appearance and requires discipline to maintain and employ, but it offers a non-lethal option that can end a fight without bloodshed. Many warrior traditions prize the Sun-Blades for their blend of martial elegance and tactical flexibility.
The Sun-Blades turn sunlight into a weapon that can drop an opponent in an instant.
Effects
— Each blade stores one stun; release via hidden stud; target resists or is stunned (rounds = failure). Simultaneous discharge from both blades increases effect. Recharge in full sunlight for at least 30 minutes.

weapons.name: Sword
weapons.notes:
The Sword is the standard melee blade in most systems: approximately three feet of blade on a one-handed grip, used for cutting and thrusting. It has been the sidearm of choice for militant orders and soldiers across countless worlds. Swords are especially valued in confined or sensitive environments—such as ship-boarding—where ranged or explosive weapons would risk collateral damage.
The blade is versatile enough for both slashing and stabbing and can be paired with a shield or off-hand tool. Quality varies from mass-produced issue blades to masterwork pieces. Power-enhanced variants exist at higher cost, adding reactive or electrical elements that increase damage when activated.
With the Sword, the wielder has a reliable, universal melee option.
Effects
— None
* Power enhanced swords are also available at a greatly “enhanced” price — double the listed price. When enhanced, a sword is fitted with a reactive solenoid which will cause the sword’s blade to lung out outward several inches if the tip experiences pressure (i.e., when stabbed into a target). The blade is also fitted with an electro-net. The net and solenoid may be activated by depressing a small button mounted on the weapon’s hilt. When activated all attacks cause an extra \+1d of damage.
The Guild is just now outfitting other medieval style weapons with power enhancements. These weapons will be released soon (as determined by your GM). All such weapons will cost twice their listed price and add \+1d to Dmg when the power enhancement is activated. (GM, only light and medium damage weapons may be so enhanced).

weapons.name: Tail Spikes
weapons.notes:
Some species remove the tail at birth; others retain it. Those who keep their tails can benefit from the tail spike implant.
Other races may only take this implant if they already have tails and a tail attack.
During this operation the tip of the tail is removed and the stump is plated. A power hinge connects the tip to the plated section and the entire process is equipped with spikes.
Tail spikes enhance a patient’s normal tail damage, increasing it by \+1c.

weapons.name: Talon-Spear
weapons.notes:
The Talon-Spear is a five-foot pole with three spring-loaded talons at one end. A rope or cord can be attached for retrieval after throwing.
The weapon may be used like a common spear. However, if the shaft is twisted, the talons widen and are spring set. When a ta-oon hits after being so set, the talons spring together. The victim may then be “reeled in” like some hapless fish. If unwilling a Str contest between attacker and victim must be made. If the weaker Str exceeds the amount of damage, the ta-oon slips out inflicting half again as much damage.
The weapon has spread to many warrior cultures.

weapons.name: Thermite Grenades
weapons.notes:
Thermite Grenades
Thermite Grenades are high-temperature incendiary devices designed for the character, a specialist in heavy assault and group combat. These grenades release a searing thermite compound upon detonation, making them perfect for breaking through enemy lines and delivering powerful fiery attacks. The Thermite Grenades are an essential tool in the character’s arsenal, turning them into a force of fiery destruction that can incinerate anything in their path.
Each Thermite Grenade is a compact, cylindrical device encased in a dark, heat-resistant alloy. The surface is etched with glowing red-orange lines that pulse with energy, indicating the volatile thermite compound inside. When activated, the grenade emits a bright, fiery glow before detonating in an explosion of intense heat and flame. The resulting firestorm is capable of reducing armor, flesh, and fortifications to ash, making Thermite Grenades a terrifying weapon on the battlefield.
In the hands of the character, Thermite Grenades become instruments of merciless incineration, leaving nothing but scorched earth in their wake.
Effects
-- Thermite Grenades release a high-temperature incendiary compound upon detonation.
-- Atk is made via Throw or using a grenade launcher.

weapons.name: Thorn Gauntlets
weapons.notes:
Thorn Gauntlets
Thorn Gauntlets are a pair of cybernetically enhanced gloves designed for the character, providing a versatile and deadly weapon that complements the character’s ability to manipulate plant life. These gauntlets are engineered to project hardened thorns for close combat, ensuring that the character can maintain battlefield control and defense while enhancing their close-quarters combat capabilities.
The Thorn Gauntlets are a seamless blend of nature and technology, crafted from a durable, lightweight alloy with an outer layer of bioengineered plant fibers. The fibers are interwoven with bioluminescent veins that pulse with a soft green light, indicating the gauntlets’ readiness. When activated, the gauntlets extend sharp, durable thorns from the knuckles, transforming the wearer’s fists into deadly weapons. Each strike from the gauntlets is accompanied by a satisfying crunch as the thorns pierce through armor and flesh, leaving the enemy reeling from the impact.
With Thorn Gauntlets, the character wields the power of nature itself in close combat, ensuring that no enemy can stand in their way.

weapons.name: Throw
weapons.notes:
Throw
This is every race's ability to pick up an good sized rock or steel ball, etc. and throw it.
Improvise: If the object is not a good natural object to throw, then the Improvised weapons should be used.
Good Thrown Items includes grenades, good sized rocks, and similar items, but does not include hurled weapons listed on the tech weapons table hereafter.

weapons.name: Throw Object
weapons.notes: Throw Object is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Throwing Axes
weapons.notes:
Throwing Axes
The Throwing Axes are finely crafted, lightweight weapons designed specifically for the character, combining their ferocity with precision and versatility in ranged combat. These axes are perfect for breaking enemy lines from a distance, allowing the character to strike with deadly accuracy before closing in for the kill. Each axe is meticulously balanced for perfect throws and enchanted to return to the character after being thrown, making them a reliable and reusable tool in any battle.
Forged from resilient dark metal, the blades shimmer with a faint, red luminescence, hinting at the latent power within. The handles are wrapped in grip-enhancing material, ensuring a secure hold even in the most intense combat situations. The axes are adorned with intricate runes that pulse with energy, enhancing their performance and ensuring that each throw is as deadly as the last.
In the hands of the character, the Throwing Axes become more than just weapons; they are an extension of the character’s will, cutting down enemies with precision and power. The ability to retrieve the axes after each throw ensures that the character is never without a weapon, making them a constant threat from any range.
Effects
-- Lightweight, finely crafted axes designed for ranged attacks (poor at melee).
-- Enchanted to return to the character after being thrown.
-- Not designed for melee; if used in melee, Atk(/2) and Dmg(/2).

weapons.name: Throwing Knives (set)
weapons.notes: Throwing Knives (set) is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Toothed Dagger
weapons.notes:
The Toothed Dagger is a long-bladed knife with one sharp edge and one deliberately jagged edge, designed to tear and saw as well as slice. It is the close-combat equivalent of a standard dagger in many warrior cultures, favored by experts who know how to maximize its unique profile. In skilled hands, the weapon can inflict severe and messy wounds.
The blade is long enough to offer reach and penetration while remaining compact enough to carry and draw quickly. The toothed edge can catch on armor or flesh, creating additional trauma on withdrawal. The weapon has spread beyond its culture of origin and is now used by anyone who wants a dagger with extra bite.
With the Toothed Dagger, the wielder carries a blade that cuts twice—going in and coming out.
Effects
— None

weapons.name: Tower Crossbow
weapons.notes: Tower Crossbow is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Trident
weapons.notes: Trident is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Trip-Stave
weapons.notes:
The Trip-Stave is a two-handed pole weapon designed for control and versatility rather than raw lethality. It allows the wielder to choose before each attack whether to trip, disarm, or wound an opponent, making it a favorite of duelists and tactical fighters who prefer to dictate the flow of combat.
When used to trip, the defender must succeed on a Def check or be knocked prone. When used to disarm, the defender may resist with either Def or Atk, and failure costs them their weapon. A standard damaging attack is resolved normally. The user must declare the intended outcome before rolling.
The Trip-Stave rewards skill and foresight, turning each exchange into a calculated choice.
Effects
— Trip, disarm, or damage: declare before attack; trip uses Def check, disarm allows Def or Atk to resist.

weapons.name: Vampiric Claws
weapons.notes:
Vampiric Claws
The Vampiric Claws are a set of retractable, razor-sharp weapons designed for the character, a fierce combatant who thrives on draining the life force of enemies to heal and empower themselves. These claws are more than just physical weapons; they are extensions of the character's vampiric abilities, enabling quick, lethal strikes and facilitating potent life drain.
The Vampiric Claws are sleek, elegant, and terrifying in appearance, crafted from a dark, flexible leather that conforms perfectly to the wearer’s hands. When retracted, the claws are concealed within the gloves, appearing as seamless extensions of the character’s hands. Upon activation, the claws extend to approximately eight inches, gleaming with a faint, blood-red hue. As the character strikes with the claws, they not only inflict physical wounds but also draw upon the life force of their enemies, feeding it back into the character’s own vitality. Each successful strike with the Vampiric Claws enhances the character’s strength, making them more formidable with every attack.
The Vampiric Claws are the embodiment of the character’s predatory nature, allowing them to strike swiftly and drain the life force of their enemies, fueling their own power and ensuring their survival in the heat of battle.

weapons.name: Venom Injector Carbine
weapons.notes:
Venom Injector Carbine
The Venom Injector Carbine is a bio-tech shooting weapon designed for the character, capable of firing projectiles infused with a potent venom derived from bioengineered flora and fauna. This carbine is versatile, designed for both lethal and non-lethal combat scenarios, delivering effects ranging from paralysis to lethal toxicity. The Venom Injector Carbine has an organic, almost alien aesthetic, with sleek lines and a bioengineered texture that seems to pulse with life.
The carbine’s body appears to be grown rather than manufactured, with components that blend seamlessly into one another. The surface is smooth and cool to the touch, with bioluminescent patterns that shift and change as the weapon charges. When fired, the carbine emits a low, throbbing hum, followed by a sharp hiss as the venom-laced bio-darts are launched at the target. The darts themselves are sleek and needle-like, designed to penetrate armor and deliver their toxic payload deep within the target's body. Upon impact, the venom takes immediate effect, spreading rapidly through the bloodstream and causing a range of debilitating effects.
The Venom Injector Carbine is a potent weapon in the character’s arsenal, turning each shot into a potentially lethal strike that can incapacitate or kill with precision.
Effects
-- Fires bio-darts. Darts can Atk\Mng normally or (see below) may be infused with lethal and nonlethal stim.
-- The basic cartridge causes low Dmg().
-- May be used to shoot targets ensnared by Entangling Burst.

weapons.name: Venom Tail
weapons.notes:
The Venom Tail is a large muscular implant that sits on the abdomen and has three stinger-tipped tails. The tails can attack one opponent per round—in front, to the sides, or behind the host. Each stinger can hold up to ten doses of poison; natural poison sacs can be added for an extra cost to manufacture paralysis poison at a set rate. With the Venom Tail, the host can strike from multiple angles and deliver toxins in close combat.
Effects
— Three tails; one opponent per round; up to ten poison doses per stinger; optional natural poison sacs (see equipment).

weapons.name: Void Sphere
weapons.notes:
The Void Sphere is a tiny hollow sphere, about the size of a cherry, that opens a localized rift when activated and thrown. A channeler must expend two power points to activate the sphere, then may throw it at a target. On impact, the sphere shatters and implodes, creating a brief wash of energy that seems to tear a small hole in reality itself.
Anyone within one square of the impact point must resist with Strength against the channeler's skill roll. Those who fail are pulled into the implosion and vanish; their fate and destination are unknown. The sphere is a weapon of last resort or absolute elimination, used when the user is willing to spend significant power and accept the moral weight of permanent removal.
The Void Sphere offers a way to make a problem disappear—literally.
Effects
— Two power points to activate; throw at target; Strength check for those within one square of impact; failure means victim is drawn in and removed.

weapons.name: Void Staff
weapons.notes:
Void Staff
The Void Staff is a formidable weapon designed for the character, a powerful spellcaster who specializes in large combat group mitigation and magical offense. This staff is imbued with void energy, capable of amplifying spells to devastating effect, making it an essential tool for controlling the battlefield and weakening enemy formations. The Void Staff is a striking blend of otherworldly elegance and dark power, its shaft crafted from a rare, dark crystal that pulses with void energy.
When the character wields the Void Staff, the dark crystal shaft absorbs the ambient light, giving the weapon a shadowy, translucent appearance. Swirling patterns of deep purple and black run along the length of the staff, pulsing with a faint, eerie glow that seems to sync with the character’s own heartbeat. The top of the staff is crowned with a large void crystal, radiating an aura of raw, untamed energy that crackles and hums with potential power. As the character channels their spells through the staff, the void energy intensifies, creating a cascading effect of dark light that engulfs the battlefield. To onlookers, the character appears as a conduit for the void itself, their power amplified by the Void Staff, capable of casting spells with unmatched force and precision.
The Void Staff is not merely a weapon but a symbol of the character's dominion over the arcane, turning the raw energy of the void into a force of overwhelming power.

weapons.name: War-Crescent
weapons.notes:
The War-Crescent is a two-handed weapon in the shape of a broad metal crescent, studded with additional points and edges. It is a symbol of martial tradition in many cultures and is taught in dedicated schools of combat. The blades and flanges can be used to hook, slice, pin, or restrain—some styles emphasize non-lethal control, while others focus on lethal close combat.
The weapon demands two hands for full effect; using it one-handed incurs a significant penalty to both attack and damage. In the hands of a trained wielder, the War-Crescent is a versatile and intimidating presence, capable of controlling the flow of a duel or cutting down multiple opponents. Its distinctive shape and weight make it unmistakable on the battlefield.
The War-Crescent rewards discipline and practice with devastating versatility.
Effects
— Two-handed; one-handed use incurs -2d Atk and Dmg penalty.

weapons.name: Warhammer
weapons.notes: Warhammer is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: WarPick
weapons.notes: WarPick is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Warrior Claws
weapons.notes:
Warrior Claws are three metal blades mounted on a forearm harness and extending from between the fingers. The blades can be retracted into the sheath at will so the wearer can use the hand normally when not fighting. When extended, they deliver serious damage in close combat and can slash or stab in a single motion.
The harness is durable and does not restrict wrist or finger movement when the claws are sheathed. Many close-quarters specialists favor the claws for their speed and the ability to go from unarmed to armed in an instant. The weapon is a statement of intent as much as a tool—visible when extended, invisible when not.
With Warrior Claws, the wielder is never unarmed in the clinch.
Effects
— Retract/extend at will; three blades; considerable close combat damage.

weapons.name: WarScythe
weapons.notes: WarScythe is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

weapons.name: Web-Ball
weapons.notes:
The Web-Ball looks like a six-inch diameter sponge and functions as a defensive weapon. Sponge balls may be tossed or rolled. When tossed, the sponge ball explodes if it hits something; when rolled, the sponge ball waits until it comes to a stop to explode.
When a sponge ball explodes, hundreds of streamers of sticky web-like slime squirt out in all directions up to two squares away. Those streamers contacting surfaces instantly adhere and become rigid, but remain sticky (much like a spider web).
Anyone attempting to force their way through the strands must overcome an 8M strength per square or become hopelessly stuck in the streamers. A square can also be cleared out if 16 points of damage are inflicted. Pulse lasers, projectile weapons and blasters inflict half damage to the strands as so much of the area is empty space.
Physical attacks (such as blows, melee weapons, etc.) causing less than 16 damage become stuck at 16 vs ST. Sponge balls and their strands are particularly susceptible to acid (+1c Dmg). If a sponge ball is destroyed before exploding, all effects are avoided. Sponge balls have a 5/2/0 (Str 16\) rating and once used they die.

weapons.name: Web-Launcher
weapons.notes:
This creature is a long worm, which forms a cocoon-like home on its host’s body. Upon command, the slinger flings out a ball of sticky, web like material.
If the attack succeeds, the web mass has hit and will burst into a shower of long, gluey runners which spread out across the victim (affects one target only). The web mass has a strong sickening sweet smell which is known to gag many victims.
The entire experience is a horrible sensation like being dipped in a vat of honey covered string.
The web’s Str is 6H. Victims who don't break free (Str vs 6H) are immobilized and may not move, although they may attempt to break free each round thereafter.
A victim may be cut free by allies if a total of 24 points of damage is caused to the web. Webs are not affected by blunt damage weapons, however acid causes \+1c Dmg to the web.

armor.name: Arcane Wardsuit
armor.notes: Arcane Wardsuit merges medieval craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology, featuring a latticework of alloyed steel plates reinforced with translucent synthetic alloys that glow with a faint, pulsating cerulean light. The suit’s contours are streamlined, with articulated joints sheathed in adaptive polymers that shift texture and opacity in response to environmental threats. A low hum resonates from embedded arcane circuitry, generating a shimmering barrier of refracted energy that flickers like liquid starlight around the wearer’s form.

armor.name: Archaic Partial A
armor.notes:
Archaic Partial A combines two pieces for moderate coverage—for example breastplate and helmet, or vambraces and greaves. The wearer gains protection to vital areas (torso and head, or arms and legs) while staying mobile. Metal, leather, and padding are used in traditional construction; each piece can be styled to match the other for a cohesive look.
This combo balances defense and agility. A breastplate-and-helmet loadout protects the core and head; vambraces-and-greaves protect the limbs.
Archaic Partial A suits warriors who want meaningful protection without the weight of a full partial set.
Effects
-- Covers two body regions (e.g. chest + head, or arms + legs); composition defines exact coverage.
-- No integrated systems; purely mechanical protection.

armor.name: Archaic Partial G
armor.notes:
Archaic Partial G combines three pieces for substantial coverage—typically breastplate, helmet, and vambraces. The torso, head, and forearms are protected, leaving the legs relatively free for movement. This loadout is common among front-line fighters who want strong upper-body and head protection while retaining leg mobility for advancing or retreating.
The armor presents a cohesive martial appearance: chest plate, helm, and arm guards in matching or complementary style. Articulated joints and padding keep the wearer effective in prolonged combat.
Archaic Partial G offers strong protection to the most exposed areas without full leg coverage.
Effects
-- Covers three body regions (e.g. chest, head, forearms); composition defines exact coverage.
-- No integrated systems; purely mechanical protection.

armor.name: Archaic Partial H
armor.notes:
Archaic Partial H is full partial coverage: breastplate, greaves, helmet, and vambraces together. Every major body region is protected—torso, head, arms, and legs—while the armor remains partial rather than a full suit. This is the heaviest and most protective option in the archaic partial category, favored by heavy infantry and those who expect sustained melee.
The full set is imposing and complete. Metal plates, leather backing, and padding are used throughout; the wearer can still move and fight effectively but carries noticeable weight.
Archaic Partial H represents the maximum coverage available within archaic partial armor.
Effects
-- Covers all four regions: chest (breastplate), head (helmet), forearms (vambraces), shins and knees (greaves).
-- No integrated systems; purely mechanical protection.

armor.name: Archaic Partial L
armor.notes:
Archaic Partial L is the lightest coverage in this category, consisting of a single light piece such as vambraces or greaves. It offers minimal and maximum mobility while protecting one body region—either the forearms or the shins and knees. Crafted from metal strips or plates on leather or cloth backing, with padding for comfort, it is the choice for those who want a touch of traditional protection without committing to a full partial loadout.
The look is simple and functional: one set of vambraces or one set of greaves, often unadorned or lightly decorated. The wearer retains full mobility everywhere else and can add more pieces over time.
Archaic Partial L is ideal for scouts, duelists, or anyone who prioritizes speed and flexibility over coverage.
Effects
-- Covers one body region only: either forearms (vambraces) or shins and knees (greaves).
-- No integrated systems; purely mechanical protection.

armor.name: Artisan Plate
armor.notes:
Artisan Plate is a heavy, full-coverage suit of plate armor reserved for ceremonial use or when maximum protection is required. Like Artisan Ring-Mail, each suit is a unique work of art, with a long and detailed history. Because plate severely limits movement and sensation, suits often incorporate small patches of ring-mail at key points to preserve some hearing and awareness—yet even then, the wearer's senses are heavily restricted.
The armor's design is imposing and iconic: overlapping metal plates, articulated at the joints, with a helm that fully encloses the head. The metal can be polished, blued, or engraved according to tradition. Donning Artisan Plate signals serious commitment to combat; the wearer trades agility and sensory acuity for exceptional protection against blows and missiles.
Artisan Plate remains the heaviest form of archaic full armor, offering unmatched protection at the cost of mobility and awareness.
Effects
-- Severe restriction to hearing and sensory awareness; apply a penalty to Awareness rolls related to hearing when fully enclosed.
-- May include small ring-mail patches to partially aid hearing; full plate coverage otherwise.
-- Best suited to ceremonial combat or situations where maximum protection outweighs mobility needs.

armor.name: Artisan Ring-Mail
armor.notes:
Artisan Ring-Mail is a masterwork suit of full-body armor, crafted using traditional methods with no high technology, yet offering remarkable protection and aesthetic detail. Weighing in at a moderate burden for its coverage, this armor consists of large, interlocked metal rings—often called ring-mail—that deflect most physical attacks while leaving enough gaps for the wearer to retain keen environmental awareness and tactile sensitivity. Each ring is hand-forged and inscribed with minute images and abstract patterns, making every suit a unique work of art with its own history.
The appearance of Artisan Ring-Mail is both martial and ornate, with a metallic sheen that varies by alloy and finish. The large rings allow airflow and minimal restriction, so the wearer can move and sense their surroundings far better than in solid plate. Collectors and warriors alike prize these suits; those made by the finest smiths command premium value and are rarely sold by their original owners.
Artisan Ring-Mail represents the pinnacle of traditional full-body mail, blending protection, mobility, and craftsmanship for those who favor archaic martial tradition.
Effects
-- Protects against most physical attacks while allowing retained tactile and environmental sensitivity.
-- Each suit is unique; hand-crafted rings may bear inscriptions or decorative motifs.
-- No technological systems; purely mechanical protection.

armor.name: Assault Armor
armor.notes:
Assault Armor is a heavier variant of marine-grade armor, built for hazardous duties such as direct assault, ship boarding, and high-intensity combat. It combines robust plating with integrated systems that enhance survivability and effectiveness in confined or hostile environments. The suit is sealed against contaminants and includes lighting, medical support, and strength augmentation to help the wearer push through resistance and complete objectives.
The armor's profile is bulkier than standard infantry suits, with reinforced joints and additional hardpoints for tools and weapons. The exterior is often finished in matte or tactical colors to reduce glare and signature. When fully powered, the wearer can operate in adverse conditions while maintaining communication, targeting, and mobility.
Assault Armor is the choice for troops who expect to breach, clear, and hold under heavy opposition.
Effects
-- Compensators, one external and one internal hard point, sealed, flood lights, genjector, strength enhancers, targeting computer, communicator kit, ultralock boot kit (included).

armor.name: Banded Armor
armor.notes: A fusion of medieval craftsmanship and futuristic engineering, this armor combines overlapping steel bands with sleek, titanium-infused alloys, forming a layered lattice that hugs the wearer’s contours like a second skin. The chestplate features a central embossment of interlocking gears, their edges etched with faintly luminescent circuitry that pulses in sync with the wearer’s movements, while the limbs are sheathed in segmented plates reinforced with carbon-fiber weave, allowing for fluid motion without sacrificing durability. A faint, iridescent haze clings to the surface, as if the metal itself hums with latent energy, and the hauberk beneath is woven from a synthetic filament that repels corrosion and dissipates heat, leaving the wearer cool even in the throes of combat.

armor.name: Bio-Tech
armor.notes:
Bio-Tech Armor Kit
Bio-Tech Armor is an extraordinary fusion of bioengineering and advanced technology, designed specifically for the character to enhance adaptability and resilience on the battlefield. Weighing only 18 pounds, this suit offers unparalleled flexibility and protection. The armor integrates an Adaptive Exoskeleton, which reinforces the natural exoskeleton with a bioengineered layer that hardens under impact yet remains flexible during movement. This adaptability allows the character to perform precise, rapid actions while maintaining high levels of protection.
The design of Bio-Tech Armor is both alien and intricate, featuring a sleek, organic appearance with a bioluminescent sheen that shifts colors depending on the environment and the wearer’s physiological state. The armor's surface is covered with hexagonal plates that pulsate with a soft greenish glow, indicating the activity of bio-nanites within. These nanites constantly repair and enhance the armor, while various tentacle-like appendages equipped with ultralock mechanisms extend and retract fluidly, securing tools and weapons with seamless precision. The armor's bioluminescence gives off a faint, ambient light, casting eerie, shifting shadows in the dark, while its smooth, organic texture feels cool to the touch.
Bio-Tech Armor is a pinnacle of biotechnology, providing the character with unparalleled adaptability, protection, and support, allowing them to excel in their role of enhancing the hive’s capabilities and maintaining technological superiority.
Effects
-- Provides adaptable and resilient protection with an Adaptive Exoskeleton that hardens under impact and remains flexible during movement.
-- Equipped with Energy Conduits to power enhancements and weaponry.
-- Effective in extreme temperatures, ranging from -60°F to 140°F.

armor.name: Blaze
armor.notes:
Blaze Armor Kit
Blaze Armor is an exceptional combination of natural dragon scales and advanced cybernetic plating, crafted specifically for the character to dominate in frontline combat. This 35-pound armor not only provides unparalleled protection but also enhances the wearer's offensive capabilities. The dragon scales offer inherent thermal resistance and remarkable durability, while the cybernetic plating boosts physical strength and absorbs impacts from both physical and energy-based attacks, making it a formidable defense against a wide range of threats.
Visually, Blaze Armor is a striking blend of sleek black metal with deep red and orange accents, its surface etched with intricate dragon scale patterns that convey both its power and otherworldly origins. The armor includes integrated Thermal Resistance, ensuring immunity to high temperatures and fire-based assaults. Additionally, Energy Shields bolster defense against all forms of attacks, while the Reinforced Structure amplifies the wearer’s strength, allowing them to break through enemy lines with ease. Adaptive Camouflage further enhances its versatility by enabling temporary invisibility, perfect for executing surprise attacks or evasive maneuvers.
As the ultimate fusion of ancient dragon resilience and cutting-edge technology, Blaze Armor equips the character with unmatched strength and fiery power, making them an unstoppable force on the battlefield.

armor.name: Bloodweave
armor.notes:
Bloodweave Armor Kit
Bloodweave Armor is a masterpiece of bioengineering and dark magic, crafted specifically to enhance the character's vampiric abilities and provide exceptional protection in battle. This armor, weighing 20 pounds, is not only a formidable defense against physical and magical attacks but also a living extension of the character, amplifying their natural healing abilities while maintaining peak combat performance. The Bio-Regenerative Fabric woven into the armor allows it to self-repair minor damage and enhances the character’s own regenerative powers, ensuring they remain at their best even in the heat of battle.
The Bloodweave Armor is a striking sight to behold, with a dark, blood-red hue accented by black, giving it a menacing yet elegant appearance. Intricate, vein-like patterns run across the armor, pulsing with dark energy, reflecting its life-draining capabilities. Quantum Reinforced Plates are strategically placed to protect vital areas, made from energy-absorbing materials that reduce the impact of incoming attacks. The armor is also highly versatile, with attachment points and hidden compartments for weapons and gear, while the Cloak of Shadows upgrade grants the wearer temporary invisibility, perfect for executing stealth attacks or escaping dangerous situations.
When donned, the armor melds seamlessly with the character, its dark patterns glowing faintly with a sinister energy that seems to pulse with every heartbeat. The character moves with a fluid grace, the armor's flexibility allowing for rapid, precise movements essential for close-quarters combat. The fabric absorbs sound, rendering the character nearly silent as they move, adding an element of dread for their enemies. The blood-red veins that course through the armor hint at its dark power, drawing strength from the life force of enemies and feeding it back to the character, ensuring they remain strong and unyielding in battle.
Bloodweave Armor is the epitome of the character's dark power, providing unparalleled protection, healing, and combat prowess, allowing them to dominate the battlefield and sustain themselves through the life force of their enemies.
Effects
-- Always in Effect
-- -- Armor self-repairs minor damage due to its Bio-Regenerative Fabric.
-- -- Armor operates effectively in extreme temperatures ranging from -50°F to 140°F.

armor.name: Brigandine
armor.notes: A hybrid of medieval craftsmanship and futuristic engineering, the Brigandine merges interlocking steel plates with a lattice of carbon-fiber reinforced polymer, its surface etched with faintly glowing circuitry that pulses in sync with the wearer's movements. The cuirass conforms to the body with a second-skin precision, its overlapping scales layered over a flexible exoskeleton of nano-armor that shifts hue in response to environmental threats, while articulated joints allow for fluid motion without sacrificing defense. A faint, prismatic aura hovers just above the armor's surface, as if the metal itself is alive, and the shoulder guards taper into sleek, aerodynamic curves reminiscent of both heraldic crests and modern aerospace design.

armor.name: Carapace Armor
armor.notes:
Carapace Armor is among the most effective bio-armors: a living shell with tendons and mantles along its length that open like a clam shell and then close snugly around the wearer. It is heavy, but its protection rivals that of top-tier marine armor. The shell seals itself airtight and filters outside air to maintain a breathable environment; the front is left clear so vision is unimpeded. Bio-engineers can produce carapaces tailored to different species by special arrangement and exchange of valuable materials.
The armor's appearance is organic and imposing—a curved, naturalistic shell with a smooth or textured surface that can vary in color and thickness. Donning it requires the shell to open and then contract around the user, after which it feels like a second skin. The combination of living structure and sealed environment makes it a premium choice for those who can obtain and maintain it.
Carapace Armor is the pinnacle of living armor, offering marine-grade protection and full environmental sealing.
Effects
-- Living shell provides protection comparable to heavy marine armor; seals airtight and filters air for breathing.
-- Front left clear for unimpaired vision.
-- Can be tailored to different species by special order.

armor.name: Chain Shirt
armor.notes: Chain Shirt is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Cyber A
armor.notes:
Cyber A adds torso and both forearms to the facial plating. The wearer has chest or back coverage (or one major torso surface), full facial armor, and both forearms plated. This moderate coverage protects the core and arms while leaving the upper arms and legs unarmored. The plating is integrated across regions for a cohesive cyber look.
The result is a clear step up from Cyber L: face, torso (one side), and both forearms in metallic armor.
Effects
-- Covers face, one torso surface (chest or back), and both forearms.
-- Component regions integrate for a single Cyber A loadout.

armor.name: Cyber G
armor.notes:
Cyber G extends coverage to full torso (chest and back), full facial armor, and both arms in full—forearm and upper arm on each side. The wearer's core, head, and arms are fully protected by cyber plating; only the legs remain unarmored. This substantial loadout is for those who expect heavy contact in the upper body and want maximum arm and torso protection.
The silhouette is imposing: torso, face, and both arms in seamless or articulated cyber armor, often with tribal or symbolic detailing.
Cyber G offers near-complete upper-body cyber protection.
Effects
-- Covers full torso (chest and back), face, and both arms (forearm + upper arm each).
-- Legs are not covered.

armor.name: Cyber H
armor.notes:
Cyber H is full-body partial cyber armor: torso (chest and back), facial plating, both arms (forearm and upper arm each), and both legs (thigh, knee, and shin each). Every major region is covered with integrated cyber plating, creating a complete partial suit. The armor is still classified as partial rather than full suit armor but represents the maximum coverage available in the cyber armor line.
The wearer is fully plated from head to foot in gleaming metallic armor, with articulated joints at knees, elbows, and waist.
Cyber H is the pinnacle of cyber partial armor.
Effects
-- Covers full torso, face, both arms (forearm + upper arm each), and both legs (thigh + knee + shin each).
-- Full-body partial cyber; all regions integrated.

armor.name: Cyber L
armor.notes:
Cyber L is minimal cyber armor coverage: facial plating plus one forearm. The face is protected by gleaming metallic half-face armor, often used alongside cyber-eyes and inscribed with runes or symbolic images. One forearm is fully plated and integrated with the user's cybernetic framework. Together they offer light partial protection for those who want a visible cyber look without heavy coverage.
The appearance is distinctive but limited—half face and one arm in metal, the rest of the body unarmored.
Cyber L provides the lightest cyber armor option while still signaling the wearer's augmentation.
Effects
-- Covers roughly half the face and one forearm only.
-- Often paired with cyber-eyes or other facial modifications.

armor.name: Denim Battle Vest
armor.notes: Denim Battle Vest is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Dragon Scale Armor
armor.notes: Dragon Scale Armor is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Ethereal
armor.notes:
Ethereal Armor Kit
Ethereal Armor is a masterful fusion of agility and protection, crafted specifically for the character to enhance their melee prowess and channel Aether energy into their combat techniques. Weighing just 12 pounds, this sleek armor is made from Aether Weave Fabric, a cutting-edge textile infused with Aether energy that enhances the wearer’s speed, agility, and precision while providing lightweight protection.
When the character dons the Ethereal Armor, they feel an immediate connection to the Aether energy flowing through the intricate patterns and glowing runes that adorn its surface. The armor fits like a second skin, allowing for unrestricted movement, while the Aether Resonance Plates provide critical reinforcement in key areas. The Phantom Cloak upgrade can be activated, causing the armor to shimmer and fade from view, rendering the character nearly invisible as they prepare to strike from the shadows. The compact Aether core hums quietly, powering the armor’s enhancements and ensuring that the character remains a formidable force in any combat scenario.
With Ethereal Armor, the character becomes a swift and silent warrior, capable of executing devastating techniques with unmatched precision and grace.
Effects
-- Lightweight armor designed for agility and enhanced melee capabilities through Aether energy.
-- Powered by an Aether core that requires periodic recharging.

armor.name: Expedition Armor
armor.notes:
Expedition Armor is heavier than standard trooper armor and is typically issued to infantry who expect heavy firepower or prolonged resistance. Door gunners, vehicle crews, and dismounted troops in contested zones often wear this style for the extra protection and the ability to operate for extended periods with integrated nutrition and medical support. It offers a balance between mobility and durability for sustained operations.
The suit features plated coverage over a durable undersuit, with one external hard point for mission-specific gear. Integrated systems include targeting, communications, and illumination, plus nutrijector and slap-o-matic for field care. The overall look is utilitarian and robust, suited to long patrols and harsh environments.
Expedition Armor supports troops who need to hold the line and stay effective when resupply is delayed.
Effects
-- One external hard point, nutrijector, slap-o-matic, targeting computer, communicator kit, illuminator kit (included).

armor.name: Field Plate
armor.notes: Field Plate is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Flak
armor.notes:
Flak is a generic term for infantry body armor consisting of metal, ceramic, or plastic plates sewn or bonded into a vest and pants. Lightweight and affordable, it is widely used by infantry, irregulars, and anyone who needs basic protection without the cost or weight of full tactical armor. The plates distribute impact and stop or reduce penetration from small arms and fragmentation.
The look is utilitarian: webbing or fabric carriers hold rigid panels over the torso and sometimes the limbs. Colors and cuts vary by force and supplier. Flak offers no sealed environment, no powered systems, and minimal coverage compared to full suit armor—but it is easy to don, maintain, and replace.
Flak provides practical, budget-friendly protection for frontline roles where full armor is not available or not desired.
Effects
-- Plates provide protection against small arms and fragmentation; coverage is typically torso-focused.
-- No sealed environment or integrated systems; worn over normal clothing or undersuit.
-- Commonly used by infantry, raiders, and forces with limited logistics.

armor.name: Full Plate
armor.notes: Full Plate is a masterwork of interlocking steel plates, meticulously forged by ancient blacksmiths to form a seamless second skin. Every joint is reinforced with riveted girders, and the polished surface reflects the wearer's resolve, turning the armor into a mobile fortress of unyielding defiance.

armor.name: Fury
armor.notes:
Fury Armor Kit
Fury Armor is an intimidating blend of traditional craftsmanship and advanced materials, meticulously designed to enhance the character's strength, durability, and combat prowess. Weighing 30 pounds, this robust armor offers unparalleled protection and power, perfect for breaking enemy lines and absorbing significant damage in the heat of battle. The armor is constructed from Rage Plates, a rare alloy that hardens during the character’s berserk states, and Adaptive Mesh, a flexible material that conforms to the character's movements and transformations, ensuring that their ferocity is never hindered.
The armor’s design is both fearsome and functional, with dark metallic tones, crimson highlights, and battle-worn insignias that strike terror into the hearts of enemies. The surface is covered with intricate engravings and runes that glow faintly when the character enters a rage, channeling their ferocity into raw combat power. The Adaptive Mesh allows for rapid, powerful movements, while the Rage Plates provide exceptional protection, making the character a terrifying force on the battlefield.
When the character dons Fury Armor, they become a walking fortress of raw strength and advanced technology. The armor's Combat Enhancers tap into the character’s adrenaline, boosting their physical power and accelerating healing during battle. Despite its heavy construction, the armor operates silently, thanks to noise-dampening materials, allowing the character to approach their enemies unnoticed before unleashing devastating attacks. Fury Armor is more than just protection; it is a manifestation of the character’s unstoppable rage and indomitable spirit.

armor.name: Gaia
armor.notes:
Gaia Armor Kit
Gaia Armor is an extraordinary blend of organic and synthetic materials, designed specifically for the character to master battlefield control and defense. This biotechnological marvel offers exceptional protection and adaptability, ensuring that the character remains a formidable force in any environment. Composed of plant-based nanotechnology interwoven with high-strength synthetic fibers, Gaia Armor provides both flexibility and durability, allowing the character to move with ease while being shielded from harm.
Visually, Gaia Armor is a stunning representation of the harmony between nature and technology. The armor features a palette of deep greens and earthy browns, reminiscent of a forest, with bioluminescent accents that glow softly, adjusting to the surrounding environment to enhance camouflage. The surface of the armor has a textured, natural appearance, with intricate patterns of leaves and vines etched into the material. As the character moves, the armor adapts seamlessly, its organic components shifting and growing to meet the challenges of the terrain, all while maintaining an air of silent, deadly grace.
Gaia Armor embodies the perfect fusion of nature and technology, providing the character with unmatched protection and versatility on the battlefield.

armor.name: Gambeson
armor.notes: Gambeson is a quilted textile masterpiece, woven from dense layers of linen and wool to absorb the force of blows. Its padded construction offers a surprising balance of flexibility and protection, resembling a second layer of flesh that moves in harmony with the wearer's every motion.

armor.name: Geomantic
armor.notes:
Geomantic Armor Kit
Geomantic Armor is a unique fusion of natural materials and advanced technology, crafted specifically for the character to excel in tactical support and spellcasting. This armor offers exceptional defense and mobility through its Earth-Infused Plating, reinforced with minerals and crystals for superior protection, and Adaptive Layering, which adjusts to environmental conditions. Powered by a Magitech Core, the armor enhances the character's spellcasting abilities, making their elemental magic more potent and efficient.
When worn, Geomantic Armor presents an awe-inspiring sight. The armor’s surface is an intricate blend of earthy browns and greens, with shimmering crystal highlights that catch the light and reflect the character’s connection to the earth. The runes and symbols etched across the armor pulse rhythmically with elemental energy, casting a soft glow that intensifies during spellcasting. The suit hums with a low, resonant frequency, a constant reminder of the powerful Magitech Core within. As the character moves, the armor adapts seamlessly to their environment, the layers shifting and adjusting with a subtle, organic sound, providing both protection and freedom of movement.
Geomantic Armor is the ultimate combination of natural fortitude and advanced technology, offering the character unmatched protection, mobility, and spellcasting prowess, ensuring their dominance on the battlefield.
Effects
-- Armor operates effectively in a wide temperature range (-40°F to 130°F).
-- See below for specific enhancements.

armor.name: Glowweave Robe
armor.notes: Glowweave Robe is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Half-Plate
armor.notes: Half-Plate combines the resilience of plate armor with the agility of chainmail, featuring reinforced plates on the torso and limbs while leaving the arms and legs clad in supple leather. The design strikes a balance between defense and mobility, its angular contours suggesting both strength and calculated restraint.

armor.name: Hardened Riot Exo-Suit
armor.notes: Hardened Riot Exo-Suit is a fusion of cybernetic engineering and tactical armor, featuring a skeletal framework of carbon fiber and titanium alloy. Its surface is covered in a reactive polymer that shifts color in response to environmental threats, while integrated plating offers protection against both ballistic and energy-based attacks.

armor.name: Heavy Laminar
armor.notes: Heavy Laminar is constructed from overlapping layers of tempered steel and reinforced leather, bound together with braided steel cords. The armor's layered design distributes impact across its surface, creating a visual effect of rippling metal that seems to absorb blows rather than resist them.

armor.name: Hide Armor
armor.notes: Hide Armor is crafted from the thick, supple hides of large beasts, expertly tanned and layered to form a flexible yet durable defense. Its natural texture and muted sheen give it a rugged, primal appearance, blending seamlessly with the wilderness.

armor.name: Husk Armor
armor.notes:
Husk Armor is made from the dried husks of genetically engineered seed vessels. After the seeds are released, the remaining brownish husk is roughly the size of an adult humanoid and can be tailored to fit different species. Like pod armor, it is a form of bio-armor that relies on grown rather than forged materials. The husk is lightweight for its coverage and provides good protection against impacts and abrasion, though it lacks the self-sealing and regeneration of living carapace or vine armor.
The appearance is organic and slightly rough—a brown, pod-like shell that wraps around the wearer and is secured with straps or natural fastenings. It is often used by forces that have access to bio-engineering and prefer sustainable, grown equipment over metal and plastic. Husk armor is typically less expensive than carapace and does not require the same level of care as living vine or spider armor.
Husk Armor offers solid bio-armor protection in a durable, non-living form.
Effects
-- Made from dried seed-vessel husks; can be tailored to wearer size and species.
-- Good protection against impacts; no sealing or regeneration.
-- Lightweight for its coverage compared to metal equivalents.

armor.name: Juggernaut Armor
armor.notes:
Juggernaut Armor is heavily armored, power-assisted, and built to dominate the battlefield. The wearer becomes a walking engine of destruction, capable of absorbing and shrugging off attacks that would disable lighter suits. Multiple hardpoints, joint locks, and strength enhancers allow the operator to carry heavy weapons and close with the enemy under fire, while sealed systems and integrated lighting support operations in any environment.
The suit's silhouette is imposing: thick plating, reinforced limbs, and a helm that integrates targeting and macrovisor systems. Every component is geared toward maximum durability and firepower. Juggernaut Armor is reserved for elite assault units and special operations where overwhelming force and resilience are required.
Juggernaut Armor defines the heavy-assault role, trading agility for near-unmatched protection and firepower.
Effects
-- Compensators, two external and one internal hard point, sealed, two flood lights, genjector, joint locks, strength enhancers, targeting computer, communicator kit, ultralock boot kit, macrovisor kit (included).

armor.name: Lamellar Armor
armor.notes: Lamellar Armor consists of overlapping rectangular plates sewn onto a sturdy backing, offering a balance of mobility and protection. The intricate arrangement of the scales mimics the armor of reptiles, exuding a sense of ancient craftsmanship and tactical precision.

armor.name: Leaf Armor
armor.notes:
Leaf Armor is a symbiotic vine that grows on the host's body and must be watered occasionally. The vine produces layers of tough, shingle-like leaves that absorb damage and slough off when struck, then regrow within days. A single plant produces enough leaves to last through an extended adventure, making it a renewable form of protection favored by those who can maintain a symbiotic relationship with the organism.
The armor looks distinctly organic: green or brown foliage overlapping across the wearer's torso and limbs, with a texture that is both plant-like and resilient. It does not seal the wearer from the environment but does provide meaningful protection against cuts and impacts. The vine must be cared for (water, light, and minimal damage to the root structure) to keep it healthy and productive.
Leaf Armor combines renewable protection with a distinctive, living aesthetic.
Effects
-- Symbiotic vine produces damage-absorbing leaves that fall away when hit and regrow in a matter of days.
-- Requires occasional watering and basic care.
-- Does not provide sealed environment; protection is against physical damage.

armor.name: Leather Jacket
armor.notes: A Leather Jacket is a lightweight, form-fitting armor made from cured animal hide, reinforced with stitching and metal tips for added durability. Its supple surface conforms to the wearer's body, providing a practical and versatile layer of defense.

armor.name: Marine Armor
armor.notes:
Marine Armor is heavy, well-defended suit armor and is widely recognized as the standard protection for elite marine forces. It combines full coverage with an internal environment, strength enhancers, and a full suite of tactical systems so that marines can fight in vacuum, in atmosphere, or in contaminated zones without compromise. The suit is sealed, climate-controlled, and built to withstand the rigors of ship-to-ship and planetary operations.
The armor's design is iconic: solid plating, full helmet with macrovisor, and a balanced array of hardpoints and internal slots. Integrated lighting, communicator, and targeting systems are standard, along with slap-o-matic and nutrijector for sustained operations. Marines trained in this armor are expected to operate in any environment and prevail.
Marine Armor represents the gold standard for general-purpose heavy suit protection.
Effects
-- Compensators, one external and one internal hard point, internal environment, sealed, strength enhancers, slap-o-matic, nutrijector, targeting computer, communicator kit, macrovisor kit, illuminator kit (included).

armor.name: Mithril Mail
armor.notes: Mithril Mail is a rare and lustrous armor forged from the ethereal silver-gray metal known as mithril. Its lightweight yet impossibly strong threads shimmer faintly, as if woven from starlight itself, making it a coveted treasure among warriors.

armor.name: Obsidian Carapace
armor.notes: The Obsidian Carapace is a seamless, matte-black exosuit forged from hyper-dense volcanic glass and reinforced with a lattice of nano-fibers, its surface etched with faint, iridescent circuitry that pulses with a low, ambient glow. The armor’s contours mimic the jagged, organic geometry of a predator’s skeleton, with overlapping plates that shift subtly under movement, as if alive, while its joints are lined with a slick, non-reflective polymer that repels both physical impact and energy discharges. In dim light, faint fractal patterns shimmer across its surface, resembling trapped lightning, and the air around it hums with a static charge, as though the suit itself is a conduit for latent power.

armor.name: Padded Cloth
armor.notes: A dense, quilted matrix of interwoven synthetic fibers and reinforced polymer weaves, the Padded Cloth armor forms a second skin over the wearer’s body, its surface etched with micro-channel patterns that dissipate heat and moisture. In medieval contexts, it mimics layered wool and linen, stitched with geometric precision to balance flexibility and impact absorption; in sci-fi iterations, it adopts a sleek, matte-black polymer with embedded neural接口 nodes that adapt to the user’s biomechanics. Its seams are reinforced with a translucent, honeycomb-like resin, giving it a faintly iridescent sheen under bright light, while discreet utility pockets along the torso and limbs suggest a focus on practicality over ornamentation.

armor.name: Plate Harness
armor.notes: A fusion of medieval craftsmanship and futuristic engineering, the Plate Harness is a sleek, angular exoskeleton forged from blackened titanium-infused steel, its surface etched with intricate, glowing circuitry that pulses faintly with an inner light. The armor’s overlapping plates mimic traditional chainmail in texture but are reinforced with lightweight nanocomposite plating, while a reinforced, helmet-like visor curves over the wearer’s face, its polished surface reflecting ambient light like a mirror. Articulated joints allow fluid movement, and along the spine runs a serpentine conduit of faintly bioluminescent alloy, suggesting both protection and an unseen, adaptive technological interface.

armor.name: Pod Armor
armor.notes:
Pod Armor is grown from enormous seed-pods produced by a dedicated plant. The pods are cultivated to the size of the intended wearer (humanoid or other species) and the cost typically covers the plant itself, which continuously produces pods. Once a pod is picked and used, it withers and becomes useless as armor after roughly one adventure (about two to four weeks). A healthy plant always has at least one pod ready for harvest, so users can rotate pods as needed.
The armor appears as a large, pod-like shell that the wearer steps into or wraps around themselves. It is organic, relatively lightweight, and provides good protection for its weight, but it is not sealed and does not repair itself like carapace or leaf armor. Pod armor is popular among forces that use bio-engineered equipment and can maintain the growing plants.
Pod Armor offers renewable, grown protection with the constraint of limited pod lifespan once harvested.
Effects
-- Grown pods; cost is for the plant, which produces pods continuously.
-- Harvested pod lasts one adventure (about 2–4 weeks) then withers.
-- Plant keeps at least one pod available for harvest; can be grown to fit different species.

armor.name: Power Frame
armor.notes:
A Power Frame is a military version of the industrial power lifters used to move cargo and heavy objects. It resembles an oversized humanoid framework with large mechanical claws and a partially armored roll cage to protect the operator. In addition to lifting and carrying, it is fitted with compensators, strength enhancers, joint locks, and multiple hardpoints, making it suitable for combat engineering, breaching, and heavy-weapons deployment.
The frame towers over a normal humanoid; the operator sits or stands inside, controlling the limbs and systems. Armor coverage is sufficient to protect against small arms and fragments, but the frame is not a substitute for full assault armor in open combat. It excels in logistics, demolition, and roles where raw strength and tool capacity matter most.
The Power Frame is the military heavy-lifter and combat-engineering platform of choice.
Effects

armor.name: Riot Gear
armor.notes: A hybrid of modular plating and reinforced synthetic fabric, Riot Gear merges angular, overlapping plates of darkened alloy with sleek, ergonomic contours that hug the wearer’s form. Embedded within the armor’s surface are faintly glowing etchings of circuitry, their patterns shifting subtly in response to movement, while reinforced polymer panels flex like second skin under impact. The helmet’s visor integrates a translucent, holographic display that projects tactical data and environmental hazards, its edges lined with a faint, pulsating aura of adaptive camouflage that blurs the wearer’s outline against chaotic backdrops.

armor.name: Samurai Armor
armor.notes: A fusion of traditional craftsmanship and cutting-edge materials, this armor combines layered steel plates with reinforced polymer composites, molded into a sleek, ergonomic silhouette. The helmet features a narrow, angular visor reminiscent of samurai kabuto, framed by glowing circuitry that pulses with a faint, neon-blue aura, while articulated joints are sheathed in seamless cerametal alloys that shimmer under light. A pair of curved, blade-like pauldrons extend from the shoulders, etched with intricate wave patterns that seem to ripple subtly, as if caught between solid matter and liquid energy.

armor.name: Scale Mail
armor.notes: Overlapping plates of reinforced polymer and interwoven carbon fiber form a second-skin exosuit, each scale etched with micro-grooves that channel kinetic energy away from the wearer. The armor’s surface shimmers with a faint iridescence, as if coated in liquid metal that shifts hue with movement, while embedded filaments of adaptive nanofiber tighten or loosen dynamically to balance flexibility and impact resistance. A faint, pulsating glow emanates from the joints, suggesting latent reactive properties that might deflect projectiles or dissipate heat, though its full potential remains enigmatic.

armor.name: Scout Armor
armor.notes:
Scout Armor is a lightweight suit of advanced plate affixed to a durable body suit, designed for reconnaissance, flanking, and operations where stealth and mobility matter. It is constructed with a personal stealth net that significantly increases the wearer's ability to avoid detection—granting a substantial bonus to Dexterity-based rolls opposed by Awareness when moving unseen. Compensators, internal hard point, and full communications and macrovisor support are included, along with jump-pack and oxygenator options for extended and vertical operations.
